title: 第9章 长夜漫漫
slug: 班级地铁求生全班就我一个男生
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

车厢的灯光变得昏暗。

右边的女生们都进入了梦乡。

秦守盯着天花板，睡不着。

车厢里很安静，只剩地铁行驶的低沉嗡鸣和女生们均匀的呼吸声。

秦守思绪万千。

今天一天发生了太多的事情。

他莫名其妙被拉进了这个地铁生存游戏。

现在他和九个穿着比基尼的妹子睡在一起。

换成是谁都睡不着觉呀！

自动售货机的绿灯在昏暗里亮着，像一颗悬在半空中的猫眼。

秦守过线，就是禽兽。

可如果不过线，就是禽兽不如呀！

做男人好难！

秦守用力摇了摇头，把这些乱七八糟的念头甩到脑后。

他强迫自己冷静。

“想点别的，想点别的——我的第三肾天赋，是不是真的精力过人……”

“咳咳，再想点别的——我的初级枪法精通天赋，除了战斗以外，是不是还……”

“冷静，要冷静啊，我再想想别的——雪儿不愧是校花，刚才她的吻又香又软——我的意思是，初始者天赋突然升级了，会不会真的和雪儿有关系？”

秦守想到林雪儿绝美的面容，以及那个主动的吻，不由心潮澎湃。

他赶紧转移自己的注意力。

“关于天赋升级——我想起来了，之前在初始站台，首杀宝箱中爆出了初级天赋石。”

秦守意念一动。

他的背包空间

两颗“初级天赋石”出现在他的手中。

首杀宝箱中一共掉落了三颗初级天赋石。

秦守之前已经使用了一颗，还剩下两颗。

初级天赋石大约拇指大小，表面流转着淡金色的光晕。

【初级天赋石】

【效果：可开发玩家的天赋，解锁特殊能力】

秦守看着手中的初级天赋石，在心中嘀咕。

“我的初始者天赋突然升级，会不会和初级天赋石有关？”

秦守话音未落。

他又发现。

关于初级天赋石的信息，多了额外一栏。

【特别备注：每名玩家只能使用一颗初级天赋石（玩家状态为已使用，不可再使用）】

初级天赋石竟然有使用次数限制，每人只能使用一次。

意味着秦守以后不能再使用初级天赋石，而且，“初始者天赋”突然升级，应该和初级天赋石没有关系。

看来明天要和姜瑶好好商量一下，剩下的两颗初级天赋石，应该给谁使用？

九个女生中只有苏青青觉醒了裁缝天赋。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

The lights in the carriage became dim.

The girls on the right have all fallen asleep.

Qin Shou stared at the ceiling, unable to sleep.

The carriage was very quiet, except for the low hum of the subway and the even breathing of the girls.

Qin Shou had a lot of thoughts.

Too many things happened today.

He is somehow pulled into this subway survival game.

Now he's sleeping with nine girls in bikinis.

No one would be able to sleep!

The green light of the vending machine shines in the darkness, like a cat's eye hanging in mid-air.

If Qin Shou crosses the line, he is just a beast.

But if you don’t pass the line, you are worse than an animal!

It’s so hard to be a man!

Qin Shou shook his head vigorously, throwing these messy thoughts to the back of his mind.

He forced himself to calm down.

"Think of something else, think of something else - does my third kidney talent really have extraordinary energy..."

"Ahem, let's think about something else - my primary marksmanship proficiency talent, besides fighting, is it also..."

"Calm down, be calm, let me think about something else - Xue'er is indeed the school beauty, and her kiss just now was sweet and soft - I mean, the beginner's talent has suddenly been upgraded, could it really have something to do with Xue'er?"

Qin Shou couldn't help but feel excited when he thought of Lin Xueer's beautiful face and that proactive kiss.

He quickly diverted his attention.

"About talent upgrades - I remembered that at the initial station, the primary talent stone was revealed in the first kill treasure chest."

Qin Shou's thoughts moved.

his backpack space

Two "junior talent stones" appeared in his hands.

A total of three primary talent stones dropped from the first kill treasure chest.

Qin Shou had used one before and had two left.

The primary talent stone is about the size of a thumb, with a light golden halo flowing on its surface.

[Elementary Talent Stone]

[Effect: Develop players' talents and unlock special abilities]

Qin Shou looked at the elementary talent stone in his hand and muttered in his heart.

"My starter talent suddenly upgraded. Is it related to the junior talent stone?"

Qin Shou had not yet finished speaking.

He discovered again.

There is an extra column for information about primary talent stones.

[Special note: Each player can only use one primary talent stone (the player status is used and cannot be used again)]

The primary talent stone actually has a limit on the number of times it can be used, and each person can only use it once.

This means that Qin Shou can no longer use the junior talent stone in the future, and the sudden upgrade of the "initiator talent" should have nothing to do with the junior talent stone.

It seems that we need to discuss it with Jiang Yao tomorrow. Who should use the remaining two junior talent stones?

Among the nine girls, only Su Qingqing awakened her tailoring talent.
